hero.title: How we protect your data, your privacy and your AI deployments.
hero.summary: Trust is built into how we design, build and operate every system. This is the framework behind that commitment — security, privacy, data protection and responsible AI, under one accountable team.

overview.heading: Security is engineered in, not bolted on.
overview.summary: Every engagement starts from a shared security baseline and adapts to the sensitivity of the work. We design controls into the architecture, the delivery process and the operating model — not as a final checklist.
overview.item1Desc: Threat modelling, least-privilege access and encrypted data flows are part of the architecture from day one.
overview.item2Desc: Development, staging and production stay isolated, with controlled promotion and full change traceability.
overview.item3Desc: Defined incident response, monitoring and access reviews — owned by a named team, not a generic mailbox.
overview.item4Desc: Quality engineering includes security and penetration testing before anything reaches a live environment.

compliance.heading: Standards we work to, stated only where verified.
compliance.summary: We publish certification and compliance status only after it has been formally verified. Where a standard is in progress, we say so.
compliance.item1Desc: Our information security management system follows the ISO 27001 control framework.
compliance.item2Desc: Data residency and processing locations are agreed per engagement, documented and enforced.
compliance.item3Desc: NDAs, DPAs and defined processing terms are standard before any client data is handled.
compliance.item4Desc: Controls are reviewed on a schedule and after every incident — not once a year.

explore.heading: Four areas. One accountable team.
explore.summary: Each area has its own framework, controls and point of contact. Start with the one closest to your question.
explore.link2Desc: How personal data is collected, used and protected.
explore.link4Desc: Governance for AI you can audit.

cta.description: Security, privacy, data protection or responsible AI — send the question and a senior MeU partner responds with a documented answer, not a sales reply.

hero.title: Security engineered into architecture, delivery and operations.
hero.summary: The controls, environments and practices that keep the systems we build and operate protected — from first commit to daily operation.

architecture.heading: Secure by design, from the first diagram.
architecture.summary: Security decisions made early cost less and hold better. We model threats, apply least privilege and encrypt data in motion and at rest before a single service is built.
architecture.item1Desc: Each system is modelled against realistic threats before implementation, with mitigations tracked as delivery work.
architecture.item2Desc: Identities, roles and service accounts carry only the permissions the work requires — nothing broader.
architecture.item3Desc: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with key management appropriate to the sensitivity of the workload.
architecture.item4Desc: Secrets never live in code or config files. They are issued, rotated and revoked through a managed vault.

environments.heading: Separated environments. Controlled promotion.
environments.summary: Development, staging and production stay isolated. Nothing reaches production without a reviewed, traceable promotion.
environments.item1Desc: Dev, staging and production run on separate infrastructure with no shared credentials.
environments.item2Desc: Changes move through defined gates with approval, testing and a recorded release owner.
environments.item3Desc: Every production change links back to a ticket, a reviewer and a test result.
environments.item4Desc: Production access is just-in-time, logged and reviewed — never standing access by default.

operations.heading: Accountable monitoring and incident response.
operations.summary: Security does not end at launch. We monitor, review access and respond to incidents against a defined, owned process.
operations.item1Desc: Logging, alerting and anomaly detection run against the systems we operate, with escalation to a named owner.
operations.item2Desc: A documented runbook covers detection, containment, communication and post-incident review.
operations.item3Desc: Access rights are reviewed on a schedule and revoked the moment a role or engagement changes.
operations.item4Desc: Penetration testing and vulnerability scanning are part of the release cycle, not an afterthought.

cta.description: Share your security questionnaire or request our control documentation. A senior MeU security partner responds with the detail you need to run your review.

hero.title: Privacy treated as a design constraint, not a disclosure.
hero.summary: How we collect, use, limit and protect personal data across the systems we build and operate — with the transparency to verify it.

principles.heading: Four principles that shape every data flow.
principles.summary: These principles are applied before data is collected, not retrofitted after a problem. They govern how we design systems and how we operate them.
principles.principle1Desc: Collect only what the engagement requires. Retain only as long as the purpose exists.
principles.principle2Desc: Personal data is used for the purpose it was shared for. Any new purpose needs a new agreement.
principles.principle3Desc: Access is granted by role, reviewed on a schedule and revoked when the role changes.
principles.principle4Desc: You can see how personal data moves through the systems we operate, and who can reach it.

rights.heading: Rights you can exercise, with a clear route.
rights.summary: Where the systems we operate process personal data, the individuals behind it have defined rights — and a documented way to exercise them.
rights.right1Desc: Individuals can request a copy of the personal data a system holds about them.
rights.right2Desc: Inaccurate or incomplete personal data can be corrected through a defined workflow.
rights.right3Desc: Where retention no longer applies, personal data is deleted on request and on schedule.
rights.right4Desc: Individuals can object to specific processing, with a review before any further use.

cta.heading1: Send it to the trust team.
cta.description: Privacy questions go to a senior MeU partner, not a queue. You get a documented answer and, where relevant, the controls behind it.

hero.title: Data handled, stored and retained under a defined framework.
hero.summary: How client and personal data is classified, transferred, stored and retired across the systems we build and operate — agreed per engagement and enforced in practice.

framework.heading: Classified, transferred, stored — by agreement.
framework.summary: Every engagement starts with a data handling agreement. The classification, transfer and storage controls follow from there.
framework.item1Desc: Data is classified by sensitivity at the start of an engagement, and controls scale to the classification.
framework.item2Desc: Data moves over encrypted channels with authenticated endpoints — no ad-hoc email or shared drives.
framework.item3Desc: Stored data is encrypted at rest, with key management and access logging appropriate to its classification.
framework.item4Desc: Processing and storage locations are agreed per engagement, documented and enforced in infrastructure.

retention.heading: Retained with purpose. Deleted on schedule.
retention.summary: Data is kept only as long as the agreed purpose requires. When retention ends, deletion is executed and verified — not deferred.
retention.item1Desc: Retention periods are set by the purpose of processing, agreed upfront and recorded per data category.
retention.item2Desc: When a retention period ends, data is deleted on schedule through an automated or owned process.
retention.item3Desc: Deletion is verified, not assumed. Records confirm what was removed, when and by whom.
retention.item4Desc: Backups follow the same retention logic, with secure destruction when their window closes.

cta.description: Share your data protection questionnaire or request our handling documentation. A senior MeU partner responds with the detail your review requires.

hero.title: AI you can audit, with humans in control of what matters.
hero.summary: The governance model behind every AI system we build: defined decisions, human control, full traceability and reversibility — designed in from the first workflow.

principles.heading: Four principles that govern every AI output.
principles.summary: These principles are enforced in the system, not promised in a slide. They shape how models are built, how outputs are used and how exceptions are handled.
principles.principle1Desc: Critical decisions require human approval before they take effect — no silent automation.
principles.principle2Desc: Every output records its inputs, model version, confidence score and the reviewer who signed it off.
principles.principle3Desc: Outputs below a confidence threshold route to a reviewer queue, never straight to action.
principles.principle4Desc: Automated actions can be rolled back, with audit trails that survive the rollback.

lifecycle.heading: Governed from assessment to operation.
lifecycle.summary: Responsible AI is a lifecycle, not a launch. Each phase has its own controls, owners and review gates.
lifecycle.item1Desc: Every AI use case is assessed for risk, data sensitivity and human-control requirements before build.
lifecycle.item2Desc: Models are built with evaluation sets, bias checks and confidence thresholds defined before deployment.
lifecycle.item3Desc: Models reach production through controlled promotion, with a documented owner and rollback plan.
lifecycle.item4Desc: Live models are monitored for drift, performance and exceptions, with scheduled review and retraining.

cta.heading1: Bring it to the trust team.
cta.description: Share the use case and the decision it automates. A senior MeU AI partner reviews the governance fit and responds with a documented point of view.

hero.title: How we use cookies, stated plainly.
hero.summary: Cookies are used only where they serve a clear purpose on this site — to keep the site working, to remember your preferences and to understand how content is used. No advertising or profiling cookies are set.

categories.heading: Four categories. Only the ones the site needs.
categories.summary: Each category has a defined purpose. We do not add cookies that fall outside these categories, and we do not sell data collected through them.
categories.item1Desc: Cookies required for the site to function — session continuity, security and load balancing. These cannot be disabled without breaking core features.
categories.item2Desc: Cookies that remember choices you make, such as language and region, so the site works the way you expect on return visits.
categories.item3Desc: Cookies that aggregate how visitors use the site so we can improve content and navigation. Data is anonymised and reviewed in summary, not per individual.
categories.item4Desc: We do not set advertising, cross-site tracking or profiling cookies. This site is not funded by ad networks, so there is no reason to add them.

control.heading: You stay in control of what stays.
control.summary: You can review, adjust or remove cookies at any time through your browser or the controls described below. Disabling some cookies will affect how parts of the site behave.
control.item1Desc: Every mainstream browser lets you view, block or delete cookies per site. We document the links to the relevant settings for the browsers we support.
control.item2Desc: Where a preference banner is shown, your choices are stored and respected on subsequent visits. You can revisit and change those choices at any time.
control.item3Desc: For analytics cookies set through a third party, we link to the provider's opt-out so you can exercise control at the source, not just on this site.

cta.heading1: Send it to the trust team.
cta.description: If you need clarity on a specific cookie or want the detail behind a category, a senior MeU partner responds with a documented answer.

terms.item2Desc: Content on this site is provided for information about MeU's services. You may view, download and share content for internal evaluation, not for resale or redistribution as your own.
terms.item3Desc: Site content — including text, graphics, logos and structure — is owned by MeU or its licensors. Trademarks and branding may not be used without prior written consent.
terms.item4Desc: This site is provided on an 'as is' and 'as available' basis. To the extent permitted by law, MeU is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of the site.

responsibilities.heading: What each side is responsible for, and how terms evolve.
responsibilities.summary: These points keep expectations clear on both sides and explain how updates to the terms are handled over time.
responsibilities.item1Desc: You agree not to misuse the site — including attempting to gain unauthorised access, introducing malicious code or disrupting normal operation. Activity is logged for security.
